title: Balancing Games: Fun or Addiction? Crafting a Mithaq (Agreement)
summary: Signs of addiction (WHO): loss of control, gaming taking priority over life, continuation despite harm. The solution is not prohibition but a mithaq (agreement): (1) fixed daily time (2) no gaming before duties/sleep (3) breaks every hour (4) real alternatives: sports, hobbies, real-life friends. Parents: monitor mood, sleep, and studies.
try_this: This week: design together a "Mithaq for Balanced Gaming"—write down: hours, conditions, penalties/rewards. Sign it, and review weekly.
reflection_prompts: Did you adhere to the mithaq?
Which alternative did you enjoy the most?
